subject: gk
question: Which state government had launched the 'Jagananna Thodo' scheme in November 2020 to provide interest-free loans to small traders and artisans?
solution:
The correct answer is __Andhra Pradesh.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Andhra Pradesh CM Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy has launched the Jagananna Thodu scheme.
 
• Under this, an amount of ₹905 crores was deposited into the bank accounts of* *9.05 lakh small traders towards the provision of an interest-free loan.
 
• The government will be paying interest of ₹60 crore to ₹100 crore annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Andhra Pradesh:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy.
 
• Governor - Biswabhusan Harichandan.
 
• Number of Districts - 13.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 25.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 11.
 
 

54:T
